overview.name: Nilkantha Multiple Campus
overview.description: Community campus affiliated to Tribhuvan University, campus code 375, established in 2057 BS. UGC QAA-accredited on 22 June 2020. Official site states it runs B.Ed., BBS, M.Ed., BA and MBS; admission notices also cover BICTE. Edusanjal records that Ganesh Himal Campus, Nilkantha, was merged into this campus by a TU decision dated 2080-4-7. Reported scale is about 1,000 students.
overview.mission: To provide affordable, inclusive, and transformative education, ensuring access to all learners irrespective of socio-economic background.
overview.vision: Leading educational and research-based institution of the country by delivering demand-based academic programs

faqs.question: Is B.Ed. available at Nilkantha Multiple Campus?
faqs.answer: Yes. Nilkantha Multiple Campus offers the Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) program.

faqs.question: Which university is B.Ed. affiliated with at NMC?
faqs.answer: B.Ed. at NMC is affiliated with Tribhuvan University (TU).

overview.name: Adarsha Multiple Campus
overview.address: Gajuri Rural Municipality-1, Gajuri Bazar, Dhading, Nepal
overview.description: Non-profit community campus affiliated to Tribhuvan University, established in 2063 BS (2006 AD) with the initiation of Rajendra Prasad Pandey. Campus strategic plan states it began with B.Ed., added management in 2064 BS, and introduced M.Ed. in Education Planning and Management and Nepali Education in 2075 BS. HEIMS 2081/82 records BBS, B.Ed. and M.Ed. enrollment. A two-storey building built with Indian grant assistance was inaugurated on 26 June 2023.
overview.vision: To educate and empower helpless and neglected, disabled, indigenous and culturally backward students.

updates.title: Inauguration of Adarsha Multiple Campus building
updates.summary: Prime Minister Pushpa Kamal Dahal inaugurated a two-storey campus building constructed with Government of India financial assistance of NPR 41.20 million.

faqs.question: Where is the M.Ed. program conducted?
faqs.answer: The M.Ed. program runs at Adarsha Multiple Campus in Gajuri, Dhading, Nepal.

qa.question: What M.Ed. specializations are published for Adarsha Multiple Campus?
qa.answer: Education Planning and Management (EPM) and Nepali Education, started in 2075 BS.

overview.name: Chandrodaya Multiple Campus
overview.address: Benighat Rorang Rural Municipality-5, Bishaltar, Dhading, Nepal
overview.description: Community campus affiliated to Tribhuvan University, established in 2066 BS (2009 AD) at Bishaltar. It runs BBS and B.Ed. under the TU annual system. HEIMS 2081/82 records 149 students in BBS and B.Ed. An older directory page lists establishment as 2016 BS, which conflicts with the 2066 BS date used by the campus profile.

overview.name: CP College
overview.address: Nilkantha Municipality-4, CP Chowk, CP Nagar, Dhading, Nepal
overview.description: Private TU-affiliated college established in 2010 AD (2067 BS), approved by the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology. It offers BBS and is described as a sister organization of Children Park Secondary Boarding School. HEIMS 2081/82 records 22 BBS students. TU affiliation lists include CP College, Dhading.

faqs.question: What is the duration of the BBS program at CP College, Dhading?
faqs.answer: The published course page lists BBS as a 4-year, full-time program.

overview.name: Dhading Multiple Campus
overview.address: Prithivi Highway, Galchhi Rural Municipality-4, Mastar, Dhading, Nepal
overview.description: Community campus established in 2067 BS (2010 AD), affiliated to Tribhuvan University, running a four-year BBS program. A TU exam-centre list also records the campus as Dhading Multiple College, Mastar, Baireni-7, Dhading. HEIMS 2081/82 lists Dhading Multiple College, Dhading. Campus chief is published as Hark Bahadur Jagari.

overview.name: Dhunibesi Adarsha Campus
overview.description: Community campus affiliated to Tribhuvan University, established in 2009 AD (2066 BS). CollegeNP places it at Dhunibeshi-3, Chhatrepati; Edusanjal lists Jeevanpur-6, Dhunibeshi. It runs four-year B.Ed. and BBS. HEIMS 2081/82 records 93 students in BBS and B.Ed. Campus chief is published as Jeevnath Dhakal.

overview.name: Machchhindra Multiple Campus
overview.address: Dhunibeshi Municipality Ward No. 7, Khanikhola, Naubise, Dhading, Nepal
overview.description: Community campus established in 2010 AD (2066 BS), affiliated to Tribhuvan University. Current Edusanjal, CollegeNP and HEIMS 2081/82 listings give BBS and BA, not B.Ed. BA subject areas published as Nepali, Sociology and RD. HEIMS records 223 students. An older directory page that listed B.Ed. conflicts with these later sources.

overview.name: Netrawati Community Multiple Campus
overview.address: Tripurasundari Rural Municipality-7, Khahare, Dhading, Nepal
overview.description: Community campus established in 2064 BS at Khahare, about 34 km north of Dhadingbesi, through local initiative linked with Shree Achane Secondary School. Edusanjal also lists the place as Tripureshor. Campus profiles state B.Ed. since 2064 BS and BBS since 2070 BS. HEIMS 2081/82 records only B.Ed. enrollment (44 students). NPCA lists campus chief Basudev Sedai.

faqs.question: Where is the BBS program offered?
faqs.answer: At Netrawati Community Multiple Campus in Tripurasundari Rural Municipality-7, Khahare, Dhading.

faqs.question: Which university is the BBS program affiliated with?

qa.question: When did B.Ed. and BBS start at this campus according to published profiles?
qa.answer: B.Ed. since 2064 BS (2007/08 AD); BBS since 2070 BS (2013/14).

overview.name: Salyantar Campus
overview.address: Tripurasundari Rural Municipality-1, Aarughat Road, Salyantar, Dhading, Nepal
overview.description: Community campus established in 2064 BS (2008 AD), affiliated to Tribhuvan University, running four-year B.Ed. and BBS under the annual system. HEIMS 2081/82 records 140 students in BBS and B.Ed. Published scholarship types include merit-based, need-based, inclusive quota, UGC, local-government recommendation and endowment-fund scholarships.

faqs.question: What bachelor programs are available at Salyantar Campus?
faqs.answer: Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) and Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS), both four-year full-time programs under the annual examination system.

faqs.question: Does Salyantar Campus provide internship opportunities?
faqs.answer: Yes. Internship arrangements are published for banks and financial institutions.

overview.name: Saphal College
overview.description: Bachelor-level arm of Success Academy / Saphal College. The school site says the academy was established in 2068 BS, plus-two in 2074 BS, and bachelor study in 2070 BS, and states TU affiliation. HEIMS 2081/82 records Saphal College, Dhading, with BBS and 50 students. A TU BBS exam-centre list places Saphal College at Baireni-8, Galchhi, Dhading. The website text also mentions management and humanities at bachelor level, but only BBS is confirmed in HEIMS.

overview.name: Namuna Bageshwori Multiple Campus
overview.address: Galchhi Rural Municipality-6, Baireni Bazar, Dhading, Nepal
overview.description: Community campus established in 2067 BS (2010 AD), affiliated to Tribhuvan University, offering four-year BBS and B.Ed. HEIMS 2081/82 lists Shree Namuna Bageshworee Multiple Campus, Dhading, with BBS and B.Ed. and 87 students. Edusanjal’s district list places Baireni under Benighat Rorang, which conflicts with the Galchhi-6 address used by CollegeNP and a news video. A TU exam-centre list once recorded Baireni-9.

overview.name: Simle Mahakali Multiple Campus
overview.address: Thakre Rural Municipality-2, Simle, Dhading, Nepal
overview.description: Community campus established in 2069 BS (2012 AD), affiliated to Tribhuvan University, offering BBS and B.Ed. with English and Nepali majors. HEIMS 2081/82 records 112 students in BBS and B.Ed. Campus chief is published as Dinesh Regmi. Bachelor programs are also described as running under this campus at Mahakali Secondary School, Simle.

overview.name: Dhading Polytechnic Institute
overview.description: CTEVT constituent technical institute established in 2075 BS (2018 AD). Edusanjal and CollegeNP state it offers diploma programs in Agriculture (Plant Science) and Agriculture (Animal Science). A CTEVT institutional list records 40 seats in each program. These are diploma programs, not university bachelor degrees.

updates.title: Dhading Polytechnic Institute Admission for Diploma in Plant Science
updates.summary: CollegeNP listed an admission update for the Diploma in Plant Science.

overview.name: Nilkantha Polytechnic Institute
overview.description: CTEVT constituent technical institute established in 2079 BS (2022 AD). Edusanjal states it offers three-year Diploma in Civil Engineering specialized in Hydropower and Diploma in Automobile Engineering. CollegeNP details the hydropower diploma with intake 48 and 4 scholarship seats. A Ministry listing also classifies the hydropower diploma as a constituent CTEVT program in Nilakantha. These are diploma programs, not university bachelor degrees.

overview.name: Janaswasthya Tatha Prabidhik Adhyayan School
overview.description: Listed among CTEVT diploma/certificate institutions in Dhading. A CTEVT health-program directory lists Health Assistant (General Medicine) at Janaswasthya Tatha Prabidhik Adhyayan School, Nilkantha. CTEVT exam-centre notices assign the school to Dhading centres. A 2019 video title places a similarly named school at Chaptari, Dhading. No official phone, fee, or establishment year was found on the pages opened. This is a CTEVT diploma/certificate program, not a university bachelor campus.
